summary: MITRE plans to build a local guide to network usage to supplement the Resources Notebook, built in NLS from local users' experience. It outlines the proposed files and says useful information would be sent to the NIC.

plainLanguage.summary: MITRE planned a local guide to help its users work with remote network resources. The guide would explain how to access systems and would share useful information with the NIC.

subtitle: A plan for a practical, locally tailored guide to network resources.

tldr.problem: Network users unfamiliar with remote systems, terminology and documentation needed practical guidance for using resources at other hosts.
tldr.mechanism: MITRE planned to build an NLS guide with a locator and site files describing systems, accounts, availability, documentation and user experience.
tldr.outcome: The guide would supplement the Resources Notebook and share information with the NIC for possible inclusion in its materials.

sections.title: The Local Network Guide
sections.content:
MITRE planned a Guide to Network Usage to supplement the Resources Notebook and other NIC documentation. It would be tailored to MITRE users and include information based on actual experience with network systems and subsystems.

The guide was intended to help people unfamiliar with the network, its terms and its reference materials use resources at remote hosts.
sections.plainLanguage: MITRE wanted to turn practical experience into instructions for local users. The guide would help people learn how to use remote systems.

sections.title: Guide Structure
sections.content: The guide would be implemented in NLS. A Resource Locator File would list site files and subsystems, with links to the corresponding descriptions. Each site file would cover system availability, accounts and login procedures, charges, documentation, equipment considerations and comments on reliability and performance.
sections.plainLanguage: A locator would point users to a file for each site. Those files would explain access, accounts, hours, costs, documentation and practical experience.

sections.title: Sharing Information
sections.content:
MITRE planned to include sites as local users gained experience with remote systems, especially sites useful to MITRE projects. It intended to coordinate with a similar effort at the National Bureau of Standards.

Information appropriate for the NIC but not yet included would be submitted for inclusion. Although designed for MITRE users, the guide would be accessible to other network users through NLS.
sections.plainLanguage: MITRE planned to add sites as users learned about their systems. Useful information could also be sent to the NIC, and other network users could access the guide.
